sentences.en: The slave wants to drink, but hears that Syra is running.

sentences.la: Mercātor videt Cornēlium mūrōs petere.
sentences.en: The merchant sees that Cornelius is seeking the walls.

sentences.la: Iūlius Cornēlium laetum plōrāre nōn audit.
sentences.en: Julius does not hear that happy Cornelius is crying.

sentences.la: Domina sē ā Cornēliō aspicī audit.
sentences.en: The mistress hears that she is being looked at by Cornelius.

sentences.la: Mēdus Albīnum foedum exīre audit.
sentences.en: Medus hears that ugly Albinus is going out.

sentences.la: Aemilia līberōs in hortō iacēre videt.
sentences.en: Aemilia sees that the children are lying down in the garden.

sentences.la: Māter Dēliam amīcam esse videt.
sentences.en: The mother sees that Delia is friendly.

sentences.la: Iūlia nūntium ā līberīs vehī videt.
sentences.en: Julia sees that the messenger is being carried by the children.

sentences.la: Ursus puerōs abīre nōn posse videt.
sentences.en: Ursus sees that the boys cannot go away.

sentences.la: Audit Iūlius Iūliam in cubiculō tacēre.
sentences.en: Julius hears that Julia is silent in the bedroom.

sentences.la: Domina lūdere vult, sed patrem plōrāre audit.
sentences.en: The mistress wants to play, but hears that the father is crying.

sentences.la: Iūlia videt dominōs fēminam amāre.
sentences.en: Julia sees that the owners love the woman.

sentences.la: Māter puellās pecūniōsās canere nōn audit.
sentences.en: The mother does not hear that the rich girls are singing.

sentences.la: Nūntius sē ab Iūliā salūtārī videt.
sentences.en: The messenger sees that he is being greeted by Julia.

sentences.la: Iūlius Lȳdiam pecūniōsam plōrāre videt.
sentences.en: Julius sees that rich Lydia is crying.

sentences.la: Quīntus Mārcum in cubiculō ambulāre videt.
sentences.en: Quintus sees that Marcus is walking in the bedroom.

sentences.la: Pāstor Iūliam Graecam esse videt.
sentences.en: The shepherd sees that Julia is Greek.

sentences.la: Mēdus aquilās ā Quīntō capī audit.
sentences.en: Medus hears that the eagles are being taken by Quintus.

sentences.la: Iūlia Dēliam accurrere nōn posse videt.
sentences.en: Julia sees that Delia cannot run up.

sentences.la: Videt Aemilia nūntiōs in viā dormīre.
sentences.en: Aemilia sees that the messengers are sleeping in the road.

sentences.la: Mercātor cantāre vult, sed Albīnum plōrāre audit.
sentences.en: The merchant wants to sing, but hears that Albinus is crying.

sentences.la: Mārcus audit puellās rāmōs tenēre.
sentences.en: Marcus hears that the girls are holding the branches.

sentences.la: Māter leōnem bonum iacēre nōn videt.
sentences.en: The mother does not see that the good lion is lying down.

sentences.la: Pāstor sē ā līberīs quaerī videt.
sentences.en: The shepherd sees that he is being looked for by the children.
